message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s services right now, so I can’t fetch real‑time scan results for *reddit.com* using your API key. However, you can retrieve this information yourself by calling VirusTotal’s “Domain Report” endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/reddit.com
Authorization: Bearer <your_api_key>
```

Replace `<your_api_key>` with `reddit_api_key`. This will return JSON containing all available metrics (last submission time, last activity, total votes, etc.). If you run into trouble parsing the response or interpreting specific fields, feel free to share the raw output here—I'll help explain what each part means!
